words.prose: {{ar:أَلَيْسَ}} ({{tr:ʾa-laysa}}) opens the ayah by placing the whole divine-judgment predicate under a negative question whose expected answer is yes. The word is not merely a denial: {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) first builds a copular proposition with {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) as subject and {{ar:بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ}} ({{tr:bi-ʾaḥkami l-ḥākimīna}}) as predicate, then the prefixed interrogative turns that scoped negation into compelled affirmation. Because {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) is uninflected here, the predication is not cast as a past or future event but as a standing nominal judgment. Because the predicate is bāʾ-marked, the opening word controls the full phrase rather than only a single adjective. Coming after the direct challenge of 95:7, it shifts the register from accusing the denier to making every listener complete the omitted after-all-this argument by assenting to God's supreme judgment. The same formulaic movement is visible in divine-attribute closures such as 11:90 and 75:40, while here its compactness makes the whole final ayah one tight question. The repeated l-sounds from {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) into {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) also make the negating frame and named subject feel audibly continuous.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is the nominative subject of the laysa clause, so the final predicate is anchored in the named divine referent rather than in an abstract idea of judgment or a generic deity category. Its placement before the bāʾ-marked predicate lets the listener identify the authority first and then hear the attribute: God is the one being affirmed as {{ar:أَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami l-ḥākimīna}}). The name is locally qualified by the judgment-and-wisdom field, not by mercy, power, justice-only wording, or decree-only wording; the broader divine-name pairing is familiar in Quranic judgment discourse, while this exact elative construction is narrower and more pointed. The proper-name form narrows the local work of the root: worship-reference and bewilderment-pressure can stand behind the name, but the grammar here selects the lexicalized divine name as subject. Within the surah, the explicit naming also matters: the creator implied in the first-person creation claim of 95:4 is now named at the judicial close, and the trustworthy-city frame in 95:3 is answered by named divine judgment in 95:8.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is small on the page but heavy in the syntax. In the laysa construction it functions as bāʾ zāʾida: it does not mean ordinary instrument, location, or accompaniment, yet it reinforces the negated predicate that the rhetorical question then reverses into affirmation. At the same time it is not syntactically empty, because it governs {{ar:أَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami}}) as genitive and makes the predicate arrive as {{ar:بِأَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:bi-ʾaḥkami}}), one fused written unit. This lets the ayah name {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) first, then pivot through the short particle into the full superlative claim.

words.prose: {{ar:أَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami}}) is the predicate's core word, but its grammar is deliberately compressed. It is governed from the left by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), so it appears in genitive form, and it governs to the right as a construct head whose class is supplied by {{ar:ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥākimīna}}). The elative pattern makes the claim more than 'God judges': it places God at the highest degree within the class of judging agents. The {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) field lets the phrase hold adjudication, wisdom, firm precision, and concrete restraint together, so divine judgment feels like boundary-setting control and not only a courtroom verdict; the idāfa with {{ar:ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥākimīna}}) still keeps the local sense centered on the judging class. That makes the word answer the denial of judgment in 95:7 with a concise judicial conclusion and helps ground the uncut reward of 95:6 in divine judgment. Its rare elative profile, doubled root with the following participle, and broader superlative-of-class pattern comparable to 23:14 make the close sound like a formal verdict rather than an isolated adjective.

topics.headline: governed and governing at once

topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:أَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami}}) as governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and as the construct head for {{ar:ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥākimīna}}).

topics.reason: V4 accepts judgment, wisdom, firming, and restraint branches for {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}), but the local construct with the active-participle class narrows these pressures into the judgment-class superlative rather than free polysemy.

topics.reason: The two adjacent words share {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) but differ in form, allowing a local sound-and-sense echo tied to the construct structure.

topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the ADJ_COMP form for {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) as low-occurrence, and the paired participle class is also limited.

topics.headline: final predicate turns denial into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the superlative predicate answers the denial of judgment in 95:7 and seals the surah's sequence with divine judicial authority.
topics.reason: The rhetorical-question frame follows 95:7, and the {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) superlative coherently closes the sequence that includes reward in 95:6 and denial of judgment in 95:7.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥākimīna}}) supplies the class that {{ar:أَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami}}) surpasses, so the final word is not an ornamental plural. Its genitive case closes the idāfa, and its definite sound masculine plural form names rational judging agents as a whole. The active participle presents the class through ongoing agency: judges, rulers, arbiters, governors, and limit-setters are gathered as the field over which God's judgment stands supreme. Although this active-participle group is limited, it appears inside the familiar final-question frame, so the rare class term carries a broadly recognizable divine-judgment affirmation. As the surah's last word, it refuses to let the close land on the denier from 95:7; the long -īn cadence makes the sound and sense land instead on the universal judging class and the authority that upholds denied accountability. Its shared {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) root with {{ar:أَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami}}) moves from superlative quality to agent-class, while the trustworthy frame in 95:3 is answered by judicial closure in 95:8.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is required by the construct; it supplies the class without which the superlative would be less defined.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the genitive second term of the construct headed by {{ar:أَحْكَمِ}} ({{tr:ʾaḥkami}}).

topics.headline: definite plural names active judges
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is against a definite plural class of active judging agents, not an abstract system or an indefinite sample.
topics.reason: The word is a definite masculine plural active participle in genitive, marking rational agenthood and dependent class role.

topics.headline: judges broaden to rulers and limit-setters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the class is broader than courtroom judges, extending to agents who rule, arbitrate, govern, and set limits.
topics.reason: V4 supports judgment, governance-adjacent adjudication, and restraint branches for {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}), while the local active participle keeps the selected sense tied to judging agents.

topics.headline: limited participle carries familiar affirmation

topics.reason: The contextual profile shows a small active-participle group, and the broader divine-name plus judgment field is recognized without making distribution alone create the topic.

topics.headline: surah lands on judgment authority

topics.reason: The final word closes the predicate in 95:8, answers the denial of {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīn}}) in 95:7, and can be read as a same-surah bookend with {{ar:ٱلْأَمِينِ}} ({{tr:al-amīn}}) in 95:3.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative interrogative أَلَيْسَ, the reinforcing bāʾ in بِأَحْكَمِ, and the doubled ح ك م construction أَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fixed present-state negation is turned by the interrogative into demanded assent, while the superlative and agent plural rank Allah above every other adjudicator.

activation_trace.role: Fixed present-state negation supplies the proposition whose denial the rhetorical question makes untenable.
The fixed divine name identifies the subject whose judicial supremacy is put directly to the hearer.
Adjudication among people supplies the literal court-domain comparison intensified by the repeated root.

changed_reading.before: A flat question about whether Allah is a better judge than other judges.
changed_reading.after: An emphatically framed demand for assent that Allah is the unsurpassed adjudicator, with denial itself placed under pressure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two ح ك م forms in أَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ retain a root-image of checking motion and preventing corruption.
baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment is not only a verdict but an effective restraint: it blocks injustice, turns harmful intention, and functions like a bridle that converts force into governed motion.

activation_trace.role: Restraining and turning back corruption supplies judgment's corrective action rather than merely its declaration.
The bridle-piece makes the corrective mechanism concrete as force checked and redirected.

changed_reading.before: Best judging means issuing the best verdict.
changed_reading.after: Best judging means most effectively arresting injustice and redirecting destructive motion toward right order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparative أَحْكَمِ and the agent noun حَٰكِمِينَ repeat one root while allowing perfective and juridical senses to overlap.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase compares judges while also hearing judgment as the craft of making a matter firm, complete, and truth-hitting; decisiveness is therefore constructed, not merely announced.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing firm, perfected, and decisive supplies the result produced by the superlative judge.
Rightly guided knowledge supplies the truth-sensitive intelligence by which firmness avoids becoming mere force.

changed_reading.before: The phrase only ranks one judge above a class of judges.
changed_reading.after: It also names the one whose judging most fully firms an unsettled matter and brings it to a truth-responsive completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ can profile not only the winner of a comparison but the one most fit to receive delegated decision.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question becomes jurisdictional: it presses the hearer to recognize where decision may finally be lodged and whose ruling can be accepted without appeal.

activation_trace.role: Present-state negation frames refusal to entrust the decision as the position the question challenges.
Delegation and acceptance of another's decision supply the transfer-of-jurisdiction mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The hearer is asked to acknowledge a ranking among judges.
changed_reading.after: The hearer is also asked whether any authority is more fit to be entrusted with the case.

context_deltas.mechanism: The edible whole and its oil-bearing companion activate a material analogy in which excellent judgment brings a contained value to usable expression: the decision is a yielded essence, not an arbitrary layer imposed from outside.

activation_trace.role: Perfecting and completing supplies the focus-side transformation from an unsettled case to a finished result.
The edible fig supplies a whole whose inward yield can become available and nourishing.
Oil and olive extract supply the movement from contained substance to expressed usable essence.

structural_cues: 95:1 opens with a paired edible fruit and oil-bearing fruit before the focus superlative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fruit, oil, and a perfective focus branch; I supply the arrow from extraction to adjudication as disclosure of latent value. A live alternative is that the pair remains oath scenery with no procedural analogy.

changed_reading.before: The best judge imposes the most authoritative decision.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the best judge draws a case's latent truth and benefit into a finished, usable decision.

context_deltas.mechanism: A limit at which one stops or crosses spatializes the focus-root's restraint: judgment establishes a threshold, identifies transgression, and checks motion at the right boundary.

activation_trace.role: Restraining injustice supplies the normative act of stopping conduct that exceeds a limit.
The bridle supplies a local mechanism for governing movement at the limit rather than erasing movement.
The boundary where one stops or crosses supplies the spatial threshold that judgment defines and enforces.

structural_cues: 95:2 places a named mountain expression in the oath sequence, allowing both landmark and limit imagery to remain live.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stop-or-cross boundary and restraint branches; I treat normative judgment as boundary governance. The live alternative is the proper mountain sense without an activated legal topology.

changed_reading.before: Corrective judgment restrains an already identified wrong.
changed_reading.after: Corrective judgment first makes the decisive boundary of wrong visible and then governs passage at that threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded territory joined to security and trust turns adjudication into civic architecture: the finest ruling is legible in the protected space and settled confidence it makes possible.

activation_trace.role: Judgment among people supplies the public institution operating inside the contextual civic container.
Preventing injustice supplies the causal protection by which adjudication can produce security.
A delimited place supplies jurisdiction's bounded social and spatial field.
Settled security and trust supply the lived outcome by which the quality of judgment can be recognized.

structural_cues: 95:3 binds the place noun and its security adjective into one phrase immediately before the human sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded place, settled security, adjudication, and restraint; I supply the causal arrow from just restraint to civic trust. A live alternative treats security as a property of the named place independent of courts.

changed_reading.before: Divine superiority is an abstract rank over other judges.
changed_reading.after: Divine judgment is also the ordering power by which a bounded human world can become secure and trustworthy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation as measuring, bestness, straight proportion, and appraisal make the final Judge the maker who possesses the originating specification. Judgment becomes comparison with intended form and, potentially, restoration toward it.

activation_trace.role: Truth-hitting knowledge supplies the maker's privileged understanding of what the human measure was meant to be.
Perfecting and making firm links judicial decision to the prior work of giving a form completion.
Measuring and proportioning supplies an originating specification against which later assessment can operate.
Goodness over against ugliness supplies an evaluative axis already present in the act of formation.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the target condition encoded in the human configuration.
Valuation and appraisal turn configuration into a standard that can be judicially assessed.

structural_cues: The superlative أَحْسَنِ in 95:4 anticipates أَحْكَمِ in 95:8.
The created human is the object of the measured configuration, keeping the maker–measure–judgment chain focus-relevant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, an evaluative superlative, balanced configuration, appraisal, and truth-hitting judgment; I supply the arrow that the maker's specification grounds the later judgment. A live alternative keeps creation and adjudication as parallel powers without a quality-assessment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Allah is the highest member in a hierarchy of judges.
changed_reading.after: The creator who set the human measure is uniquely competent to judge its deformation, worth, and possible restoration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding directed return downward overlaps the focus-root's turning-back branches. The Judge is therefore not a spectator who arrives after decline but the authority over trajectory, reversal, restraint, and destination.

activation_trace.role: Turning back to set right supplies a corrective counter-motion within the semantic field of judgment.
Making something return supplies the focus-side capacity to govern reversal itself.
Returning a thing to a place supplies the explicit trajectory that the final judgment retroactively governs.
Directed descent supplies the vector and destination over which corrective or punitive judgment has force.

structural_cues: 95:5 assigns the return to the first-person plural agent before 95:8 names Allah.
أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ repeats the descent root as 95:8 repeats the judgment root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agentive return, downward direction, and focus branches of turning back; I infer continuity of agency and read trajectory-management as part of judgment. A live alternative reads the descent as a condition judged only afterward, not itself as adjudicative action.

changed_reading.before: God judges the human after rise and decline have occurred.
changed_reading.after: God's judging includes sovereignty over the return, the downward vector, and any arrest or redirection of that movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception from general descent activates the form-distant exceptive branch of ل ي س. The final question then warrants a discriminating judgment that can identify trust and fitting action without flattening all humans into one outcome.

activation_trace.role: The excepting sense supplies a lexical shadow of exclusion behind the ordinary negative interrogative.
Adjudication supplies the act that distinguishes the warranted exception from the general class.
Heart-settling assent supplies one criterion by which the excepted class is differentiated.
Fitness and suitability supply the action-side criterion rather than a merely nominal group label.
Otherness, exception, and negation reinforce the contextual density of exclusion and distinction.

structural_cues: 95:6 begins with إِلَّا, grammatically carving an exception out of the preceding return.
The sequence combines an exceptive opening with غَيْرُ near its close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit exception syntax, contextual otherness, trust, fitness, and an exceptive ل ي س branch; I let that density activate an exclusion-sensitive shade in أَلَيْسَ. The live alternative is that focus لَيْسَ remains solely the ordinary negative verb.

changed_reading.before: The final question universally asserts that God is the best judge.
changed_reading.after: It also answers why the preceding exception is not arbitrary: the best judge can discriminate fittingly within a shared human trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intended action, anti-corruption, and the splinting image inside reward recast adjudication as reparative justice. The judgment answers action while also setting a fracture and restoring fit.

activation_trace.role: Restraining corruption and turning back to set right supplies the focus-side reparative operation.
Adjudication among people keeps the repair a judicial outcome rather than a free-floating healing metaphor.
Purposive action supplies the conduct to which the judgment responds.
Rightness opposed to corruption supplies the condition that repair seeks to restore.
Setting a crooked fracture supplies the concrete restorative image latent beside recompense.

structural_cues: 95:6 places purposive deeds, right-making, and reward in one consequence chain after the descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conduct, anti-corruption, reward, fracture-setting, and corrective judgment; I infer that recompense can effect restoration rather than only record merit. The live alternative restricts أَجْر to ordinary payment and leaves repair inactive.

changed_reading.before: The best judge accurately pays or sentences according to deeds.
changed_reading.after: The best judge answers deeds with a ruling capable of restraining corruption and setting what has been fractured back into fit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reward as earned recompense coexists with release without exchange and with non-interruption. The resulting justice is not a closed wage ledger: it honors action yet contains a durable, non-coercive surplus that cannot be reduced to price.

activation_trace.role: Adjudication supplies the allocation framework within which earned and unpriced modes can coexist.
Recompense and hire supply the transactional pole that answers action.
Release without compensation supplies a non-transactional pole beyond strict wage equivalence.
Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the negated failure mode, making the awarded good durable.

structural_cues: 95:6 grammatically gives the reward to the excepted group and immediately qualifies it with غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wage-like recompense, free release, and cutting-off; I read their juxtaposition as two coexisting modalities within just allocation. A live alternative selects only the uninterrupted-reward sense and leaves gratuitous surplus inactive.

changed_reading.before: Perfect judgment closes an exact account between deeds and payment.
changed_reading.after: Perfect judgment recognizes deeds without enclosing divine giving inside a merely commercial equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial after the preceding evidence and dīn as reckoning turn the two closing questions into a hearing. The addressee is not only taught that a supreme Judge exists but made answerable for attributing falsehood after the case has unfolded.

activation_trace.role: The negative proposition supplies the denial that the final interrogative requires the addressee to confront.
Adjudication supplies the hearing in which denial, evidence, and consequence become one case.
Attributing falsehood supplies the contested stance for which the addressee must account.
After-ness supplies evidentiary sequence: the denial occurs after, not before, the displayed pattern.
Reckoning and recompense supply the explicit accountability domain answered by the focus's Judge.

structural_cues: 95:7 and 95:8 form consecutive questions, so the second can answer and adjudicate the first.
بَعْدُ marks the denial as subsequent to the whole preceding sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, after-ness, reckoning, and adjudication; I infer a hearing in which the ordered context functions as evidence. A live alternative reads the questions as exhortation without a courtroom-like discourse role.

changed_reading.before: The final line closes with a general affirmation of divine justice.
changed_reading.after: It stages the addressee's post-evidence denial before the very Judge whose reckoning is being denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dīn as assent and entrustment meets ḥukm as delegated decision. The close therefore asks not only whether Allah judges best but whether the hearer will yield the case and its authority to that judgment.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped one make entrustment an allegiance-bearing relation rather than a procedural convenience.
Entrusting decision supplies the focus-side transfer of jurisdiction.
Assent and entrustment supply the hearer's responsive act toward the final ruling.

structural_cues: The object بِٱلدِّينِ in 95:7 is immediately followed by the question naming Allah and the judges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entrustment branches on both dīn and ḥukm plus the divine subject; I infer that the lexical overlap turns assertion into a jurisdictional appeal. The live alternative takes dīn only as recompense and ḥukm only as judging.

changed_reading.before: The hearer is asked to concede that Allah will judge.
changed_reading.after: The hearer is asked to entrust the disputed matter and the right of decision to Allah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates derived nominal senses around ل ي س rather than the syntax of لَيْسَ itself; it remains focus-anchored because those senses pair load-bearing forbearance with the ح ك م branch that includes wise forbearance. Downstream prose should present it only as a root-shadow: the finest judge can bear and overlook without losing truth, not as a replacement gloss for أَلَيْسَ.

strongest_changes: The creator's prior measuring and balancing make judgment an assessment against an originating human specification, not merely a rank among courts.
Return and downward motion make divine judgment governance of trajectory and reversal, not only an endpoint verdict.

Dīn as reckoning and entrustment turns the close into both an accountability hearing and an appeal to yield jurisdiction.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated ح ك م root held adjudication, corrective restraint, truth-hitting wisdom, perfective firmness, and delegated authority together without forcing one sense to erase the others. The context then moved that cluster through fruit and extraction, boundary and secure place, measured creation, descent and reversal, exception and repair, and finally denial and reckoning; the split ر د د mapping also preserved a strange but inspectable appearance-stripping outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly أَحْكَمِ activates perfective firmness alongside the overt comparison among judges.
Whether the exceptive and forbearing branches of ل ي س are audible root-shadows here or only useful experimental activators.
Whether the non-dominant م ر د mapping should ever enter downstream prose rather than remain an explicitly contained outlier.
Whether the fig-and-oil extraction mechanism is a productive material analogy or only oath imagery.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Negation as an emphatic closure of the whole argument.** Lexical evidence: ل ي س B001, fixed negating verb for present-state denial with bāʾ in the predicate for emphasis; ء ل ه B002, fixed divine name; ح ك م B002, judgment/adjudication. Structural cue: أليس frames the final question after 95:7's "what makes you deny?" Assigned role: laysa does not introduce uncertainty; it negates the possibility that Allah is other than the most decisive judge. Abductive move: I infer that the final interrogative turns denial back against itself by using a negation that expects recognition. Reading change: the ayah reads as judicial closure rather than a simple doctrinal question.

2. **Judgment as restraining corruption, not only passing sentence.** Lexical evidence: ح ك م B001, restraining and turning back to set right; ح ك م B006, bridle-piece that restrains; ر د د B002 in 95:5, repelling/preventing; ص ل ح B001 in 95:6, setting right. Structural cue: the root ح ك م appears doubled in superlative/plural form after fall, exception, and denial. Assigned role: الحكم is a bridle and restraint that prevents the downward/corruptive motion from becoming final chaos. Abductive move: I infer that the judge's role includes corrective restraint because the packet's fall and repair branches invite that function. Reading change: "best of judges" means the one whose judgment reins in corruption and redirects toward rightness.

3. **Judgment as wisdom/perfection matching best taqwim.** Lexical evidence: ح ك م B003, wisdom and rightly guided knowledge; ح ك م B004, making firm/perfected/decisive; ح س ن B001/B002 and ق و م B008 in 95:4, beauty/goodness and straightness. Structural cue: أحكم mirrors أحسن in form and evaluative force: "best/most beautiful" formation is answered by "most wise/decisive" judging. Assigned role: final حكم completes the initial تقويم by providing a perfected evaluative standard. Abductive move: I infer a formal echo between أحسن and أحكم, both activated by measure, beauty, and decisiveness. Reading change: 95:8 reads as the epistemic completion of 95:4: the one who proportioned best also judges most firmly.

4. **Delegated judgment is withdrawn into divine authority.** Lexical evidence: ح ك م B005, delegation/entrusting decision; د ي ن B007 in 95:7, crediting a person in judgment/oath or leaving to conscience; ء م ن B002, trusting assent. Structural cue: 95:7 confronts the addressee's denial; 95:8 asks whether Allah is not the final judge. Assigned role: human conscience and social adjudication are not abolished, but the last decision is entrusted to Allah. Abductive move: I infer that the question moves from human response to the authority competent to decide the dispute. Reading change: the ayah does not merely assert divine superiority; it reassigns the disputed case from denier to final court.

5. **The brave/stationary laysa branch creates a minor counter-image.** Lexical evidence: ل ي س B004, unflinching brave one; ل ي س B005, one who stays put; ق و م B002/B016, standing and stoppage. Structural cue: this is exploratory because أليس is grammatically the negating verb, but the packet has been saturated with standing, falling, stopping, and judgment. Assigned role: the root inventory lets the final negation carry a faint image of unflinching firmness: the question does not move from its position. Abductive move: I infer a resonance, not a primary sense, between grammatical negation and steadfast judicial stance. Reading change: the final question feels like a fixed point against the earlier wavering and descent.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remains in the packet. The retrospective effect instead comes from looking backward: 95:8 gathers the basmalah's divine name, 95:4's أحسن تقويم, 95:5's reversal, 95:6's wage/reward, and 95:7's الدين into a final adjudicating point. No additional correction emerged beyond preserving the coexistence of judgment-as-court, judgment-as-restraint, and judgment-as-wise/perfected measure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **An emphatic present affirmation formed through negation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ل ي س/B001` supplies present-state negation and explicitly notes the *bāʾ* in its predicate as intensifying that negation. **Structural cue:** interrogative *a-laysa* opens the clause, Allah is its raised subject, and *bi-aḥkami* realizes the emphatic predicate construction named by the branch. **Assigned role:** negation is the rhetorical frame whose denial is itself denied, forcing affirmation of the predicate now. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies grammar but not audience response; I infer that the question expects the preceding case to make “yes” unavoidable. **Reading change:** the ending is not an open request for information but a grammatically intensified affirmation of Allah’s unmatched judgment.

2. **Judicial closure of the work-and-recompense sequence.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ح ك م/B002` supplies just adjudication among people, and the root occurs twice in superlative *aḥkam* and plural *ḥākimīn*. It is activated by 95:7’s `د ي ن/B002` reckoning and 95:6’s `ء ج ر/B001` recompense. **Structural cue:** judge language immediately answers the question about *dīn*. **Assigned role:** the first form ranks the deciding competence; the second supplies the comparison class of adjudicators. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies adjacency and repeated root; I infer that the named judge executes the account linking deed to return. **Reading change:** *aḥkami l-ḥākimīn* is active judicial closure, not merely a general title of wisdom.

3. **Judgment as restraint that turns corruption back toward rightness.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ح ك م/B001` supplies restraining injustice or corruption and “turning back” to set right. Earlier 95:5 supplies `ر د د/B001` return and 95:6 supplies `ص ل ح/B001` repair against corruption. **Structural cue:** the same short sequence moves from return, through corrective deeds, to the final doubled judgment root. **Assigned role:** *ḥukm* is the bracing action that stops corrupt motion and directs it toward soundness. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies return, repair, and restraint but not the causal chain; I infer misdirection → restraint/return → setting right as one judicial mechanism. **Reading change:** “most *aḥkam*” can mean the most effective restrainer and corrector, not only the issuer of verdicts.

4. **Perfected formation answered by perfected decision.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ح ك م/B004` supplies making a thing firm, perfected, decisive, and complete. Earlier 95:4 supplies measured creation (`خ ل ق/B001`) and straight proportion (`ق و م/B008`). **Structural cue:** “best setting” near the start of the focus window is answered by superlative *aḥkam* at its close, with descent and exception between them. **Assigned role:** creation establishes a perfected design; final *ḥukm* establishes a perfected and decisive resolution of what happens to that design. **Abductive move:** the packet does not identify one process as the other; I infer a compositional correspondence between precision in formation and precision in final determination. **Reading change:** the last title binds craftsmanship and judgment into one competence.

5. **Truth-reaching knowledge against falsification.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ح ك م/B003` supplies knowledge and reason that hit the truth; 95:7’s `ك ذ ب/B001` supplies falsehood and `ك ذ ب/B002` declaring false. **Structural cue:** the truth-status question is followed immediately by the title of the one whose knowledge reaches the right result. **Assigned role:** wisdom is the epistemic capacity that detects false attribution and lands on truth before judgment is rendered. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies opposition but not an explicit investigation; I infer falsification claim → truth-discerning knowledge → sound verdict. **Reading change:** *aḥkam* includes epistemic reliability, so the judgment is presented as informed rather than merely powerful.

6. **The question as an act of entrusting decision.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ح ك م/B005` supplies arbitration and entrusting a decision to another; fixed `ء ل ه/B001` supplies worship and the worshipped one, activated by 95:7’s `د ي ن/B001` obedience and worship. **Structural cue:** the rhetorical question asks the hearer to concede Allah’s status precisely at the point where the account requires a judge. **Assigned role:** the interrogative performs consent, *Allah* identifies the entrusted authority, and *ḥukm* names the accepted decision. **Abductive move:** the packet does not record an answer; I infer that assenting to the rhetorical question functions as submitting the dispute to the named adjudicator. **Reading change:** the final ayah does not only describe supreme judgment; it enacts the hearer’s arbitration and submission to it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists in the clipped focus window, so no later surprise emerged. The retrospective pass retained the internal double use of `ح ك م` and the immediately preceding 95:7 only as already-recorded context, not as a later activation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Restraint, Repulsion, and Repair
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Harm or corruption is stopped, pushed away, and replaced with a sound condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: restraint against corruption `ح ك م:B001/m01`, repulsion and prevention `ر د د:B002/m01`, repair after فساد `ص ل ح:B001/m02`, corrective substitution `غ ي ر:B003/m02`, repair of equipment `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Restraint blocks the damaging motion, repulsion removes it from its course, and repair reinstates sound operation. Corrective substitution supplies the practical means by which the harmful state is exchanged for a serviceable one.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exact and Beneficial Finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work is completed with precision until it is secure, sound, and beneficial.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exact workmanship `ح س ن:B002/m02`, secure finishing `ح ك م:B004/m01`, sound integrity `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficial maintenance `غ ي ر:B001/m01`, fracture mended on a bend `ء ج ر:B002/m01`, absence of useful result `ب ع د:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exact execution leads to a tightly secured and useful result. A fracture that heals crooked and an outcome with no benefit supply the contrary finish, distinguishing mere completion from sound, effective completion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Adjudication and Final Reckoning
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A measured case comes before judgment, receives an account, and culminates in the standing of resurrection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: adjudication between people `ح ك م:B002/m01`, reckoning and judgment `د ي ن:B002/m01`, resurrection and standing `ق و م:B013/m01`, prior estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Estimation frames the case, adjudication determines it, and reckoning gives the determination its consequence. Resurrection supplies the terminal scene in which those subject to judgment stand for the final account.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Delegated Judgment and Credited Testimony
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person is trusted, authorized to decide, and either credited or charged with falsehood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: delegated arbitration `ح ك م:B005/m01`, crediting testimony or oath `د ي ن:B007/m01`, assent and belief `ء م ن:B002/m01`, attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Trust grants standing to a witness or arbiter, delegated judgment gives that standing practical force, and attribution of truth or falsehood determines whether the entrusted word remains authoritative.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Penetrating and Defective Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sound discernment penetrates a matter, while weak opinion fails to reach or govern it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: right-reaching wisdom `ح ك م:B003/m01`, penetrating counsel `ب ع د:B008/m01`, weak opinion `ل ي س:B007/m01`, desirable goodness `ح س ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Penetrating counsel gives judgment depth, wisdom directs it toward the right result, and desirable goodness names its valued outcome. Weak opinion forms the reversal: a mind present to the matter but unable to penetrate it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Debt, Dealing, and Rescission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parties enter a deferred obligation, transact with one another, settle conflict, and may reclaim or unwind the exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: debt and credit sale `د ي ن:B003/m01`, interpersonal dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`, repossession and rescission `ر د د:B004/m01`, negotiated settlement `ص ل ح:B002/m01`, assessed compensation `ح ك م:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Debt creates the continuing obligation, dealing establishes the relation between parties, and settlement governs disagreement within it. Rescission and assessed compensation provide two different closures: reversing the transaction or fixing what one party owes.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worship, Obedience, and Upright Disposition
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inward character is oriented into worship, obedience, and straight conduct.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: worship and the worshipped one `ء ل ه:B001/m01`, obedience and religion `د ي ن:B001/m01`, inward disposition `خ ل ق:B004/m01`, moral straightness `ق و م:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Character supplies the inward formation, religion gives it an order of obedience, and worship directs it toward the divine. Straightness is the shared state in which inner disposition and enacted allegiance coincide.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A place becomes intelligible through prominent terrain, named stations, residence, and the civic order maintained there.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The named landscape extends from mountains and towns into lunar stations, the noonday balance of the sun, civic obedience, and habitual residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Residence, City, and Civic Obedience
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: People remain in a settled place whose identity depends on residence, assembly, and obedience to authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`, station and dwelling `ق و م:B006/m01`, city organized by obedience `د ي ن:B006/m01`, remaining without departure `ل ي س:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Residence converts land into an inhabited station, prolonged remaining stabilizes it, and civic obedience gives the settlement an ordered political form. City is therefore both a place occupied and a relation maintained.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The human collective includes manual workers and travelers, distant kin, low rank, penetrating counsel, protective jealousy, a returned woman, and the inward circle of confidants.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rank, Aptitude, and Counsel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Social position is evaluated through low rank, practical aptitude, penetrating counsel, and failure of judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: low social rank `س ف ل:B002/m01`, dullness and lagging capacity `ب ل د:B007/m01`, penetrating counsel `ب ع د:B008/m01`, weak opinion `ل ي س:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Low rank and dull performance mark diminished standing, while penetrating counsel marks valued social capacity. Weak opinion reverses the latter, making hierarchy a relation of perceived usefulness as well as lineage or position.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The human collective includes manual workers and travelers, distant kin, low rank, penetrating counsel, protective jealousy, a returned woman, and the inward circle of confidants.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Kinship, Return, and Protective Honor
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A woman returns to her family, and kinship organizes protection, jealousy, guarded closure, and their dishonorable absence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: distant kin `ب ع د:B005/m01`, returned or divorced woman `ر د د:B006/m01`, protective jealousy `غ ي ر:B004/m01`, guarded closure `خ ل ق:B012/m01`, dishonorable lack of jealousy `ل ي س:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Return places the woman back within her family network, where nearness and distance define responsibility. Protective jealousy and guarded closure express defense of that boundary, while the absence of jealousy marks its social inversion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Capacity appears as the ability to approach without fear, fit an intended role, bear a load, and continue rather than lag or stop.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human familiarity, technical suitability, warrior courage, animal stamina, bodily stature, and material strength become variations of remaining fit for engagement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Courage and Forbearing Endurance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A participant remains before danger or burden, carries what is imposed, and does not withdraw in fear.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: warrior who does not leave his opponent `ل ي س:B004/m01`, patient forbearance `ل ي س:B006/m01`, security against fear `ء م ن:B001/m01`, sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Security removes fear, courage fixes the participant in confrontation, and forbearance extends the same steadfastness into social burden. Sustaining strength explains how remaining in place becomes durable rather than momentary.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Small utterance forms organize discourse by pointing, questioning, urging, excluding, negating, calling, and answering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The demonstrative and negative surface opens into handover formulas, interrogatives, exception, the absence of anyone, divine address, the response to a caller, and the written name of a letter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Negation, Exception, and Absence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A proposition or participant is denied, excluded, or declared absent from a set or place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: predicative negation `ل ي س:B001/m01`, exception by `ليس` `ل ي س:B002/m01`, coordinating or absolute negation `ل ي س:B003/m01`, otherness and exception `غ ي ر:B005/m01`, negated-distance idiom `ب ع د:B006/m01`, absence of anyone `ط و ر:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Predicative negation denies a state, exception removes one member from a set, and otherness marks the excluded alternative. Negated distance reverses remoteness into proximity, while the empty-place formula gives negation a spatial result: no participant remains within the domain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Small utterance forms organize discourse by pointing, questioning, urging, excluding, negating, calling, and answering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The demonstrative and negative surface opens into handover formulas, interrogatives, exception, the absence of anyone, divine address, the response to a caller, and the written name of a letter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Divine Address, Amen, and Vocal Response
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A divine name is called, a response is voiced, and `amen` asks that the utterance be fulfilled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: `amen` as request for response `ء م ن:B003/m01`, divine name in address or oath `ء ل ه:B002/m01`, answer to a caller `ه ا ء:B003/m01`, letter-name and voiced `هاء` `ه ا ء:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Divine address establishes the addressee, the answering voice realizes response, and `amen` turns response into a request for fulfillment. The letter-name preserves the utterance at the level of its sounded and written form.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Small utterance forms organize discourse by pointing, questioning, urging, excluding, negating, calling, and answering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The demonstrative and negative surface opens into handover formulas, interrogatives, exception, the absence of anyone, divine address, the response to a caller, and the written name of a letter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Imprecation and Banishment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A divine imprecation verbally drives its target away from good and into ruin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ruin and curse as distance `ب ع د:B004/m01`, divine name in oath or address `ء ل ه:B002/m01`, active distancing `ب ع د:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Divine address supplies the authority of the utterance, active distancing gives the curse its motion, and ruin names the terminal state as exclusion from good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface can display form, mark, polish, defect, decay, or ornament while concealing a different functional state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human beauty reaches into pupil reflections, an intact but blind eye, facial marks, worn cloth, deceptive ornament, polished ground contact, and sealed smoothness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ground Contact, Smoothness, and Sealed Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body lies against the ground, is smoothed into an even surface, and may become solidly closed while bearing sustained contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: camel breast laid on the ground `ب ل د:B002/m02`, adhesion to the ground `ب ل د:B010/m01`, smooth even surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`, sealed solid closure `خ ل ق:B012/m01`, patient bearing `ل ي س:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The camel's breast and the adhering body establish sustained ground contact, smoothing removes irregularity, and sealed solidity gives the surface resistance. Forbearance carries the same invariant into conduct: remaining under pressure without opening, breaking, or reacting.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and implements remain serviceable through lower members, restraining fittings, handles, props, and load-bearing strength.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human and animal anatomy assembles with spear shafts, sword hilts, furniture legs, bridles, props, and the strength or weakness of a supporting rope.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bridle, Spear Forepart, and Handle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A handler orients and controls an implement or animal through a forepart, human-facing side, grip, and restraining fitting.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bridle around the jaws `ح ك م:B006/m01`, spear forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`, human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`, hilt or handle `ق و م:B012/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The human-facing side locates the handler, the handle transfers force, and the forepart directs it toward the task. The bridle completes the assembly by converting the handler's force into restraint.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and implements remain serviceable through lower members, restraining fittings, handles, props, and load-bearing strength.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human and animal anatomy assembles with spear shafts, sword hilts, furniture legs, bridles, props, and the strength or weakness of a supporting rope.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Prop, Load, Strength, and Collapse
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A prop or sustaining frame bears a load until weakness or exhaustion makes the supported body stop or fall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prop preventing collapse `ر د د:B009/m01`, structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`, sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`, frailty `م ن ن:B002/m02`, load-bearing capacity `ل ي س:B006/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prop and standing support resist collapse, sustaining strength carries the imposed load, and load-bearing capacity describes the active bearer. Frailty is the failure mode in which that same assembly can no longer hold.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life regulates opposition through confrontation, negotiated settlement, adjudication, office, custom, and governance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The peaceful and judicial frame extends into sword combat, wrestling resistance, the truth or failure of a charge, public office, habitual rule, and civic stewardship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Confrontation, Settlement, and Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Opposing parties meet, reconcile their dispute, and submit the resulting settlement to judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: confrontation and resistance `ق و م:B014/m01`, reconciliation between people `ص ل ح:B002/m01`, adjudication `ح ك م:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Confrontation supplies the opposed parties, reconciliation removes estrangement, and adjudication gives the agreement an authoritative form. The scene turns conflict into an ordered social relation rather than merely ending motion.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bu kullanımda ardından gelen öğenin dışarıda bırakıldığını ve belirtme durumunda bulunduğunu açıkça belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bu özel istisna işlevini yüklemli olumsuzluktan doğru biçimde ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca insanın yumuşak huylu oluşunu ve görmezden gelmesini değil, devenin yüklenen her şeyi taşımasını da içerir. Dal korunabilir, ancak fiziksel yük taşıma ile insandaki güçlüğe katlanma ve hoşgörülü davranma aynı üst dayanma ilişkisine bağlı farklı gerçekleşimler olarak ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Fiziksel yük taşıma, insanda güçlüğe katlanma, yumuşak huyluluk ve görmezden gelme birlikte kapsanır; bunlar yerinde kalma veya savaşçı cesareti değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Devenin yük taşıması temel fiziksel gerçekleşim, insandaki katlanma ile görmezden gelme ise kendi yapılara bağlı insani gerçekleşimler olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Yüklenen şeyi taşıma çekirdeğinden, kişinin güçlüğe katlanıp yumuşak huylu davranmasına ve rahatsız edici bir şeyi görmezden gelerek aşmasına uzanan kullanımları kapsar.

facets.statement: Devenin üzerine yüklenen her şeyi taşıyabilmesini belirtir.
Kişinin güçlüğe katlanan ve yumuşak huylu biri olmasını belirtir.
Rahatsız edici bir şeyi görmezden gelip üzerinde durmamayı belirtir.
Yumuşak huylu kişiyi niteleyen özel bir söz öbeğinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt fiziksel yük taşıma ile insanın güçlüğe katlanması, yumuşak huylu olması ve bir şeyi görmezden gelmesi arasında uzanan bir anlam alanı verir; ayrıntılar tek kaynaklara bölünebilecek ayrı iddialar halinde sunulmamıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: tapınma ve tapınılan varlık
